title: 陪伴與安定
checks: 只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. Preserve all people and their facial proportions. Live-action continuous photographic motion, restrained emotion. Close insert of the husband's navy-sleeved hands gently enclosing the woman's charcoal-sleeved hand on the same wooden table. Keep the exact hand arrangement of the reference. At the beginning, his thumb moves slowly a few millimeters over the back of her hand in one reassuring stroke. Next, their hands settle, her fingers release tension slightly, with tiny breathing-related sleeve movements. The camera slides slowly 8 cm sideways, preserving the contact point in focus, with natural depth change between the hands and the blurred notebook and tablet behind them. No new hands, no interlocking or rearrangement of fingers. No generated lettering or added graphics. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 5.167 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Low consultation-room ventilation and subtle sleeve and paper rustle. Spoken dialogue remains clear and louder than the room sounds, with no public announcements.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
